[Toolchain PR #99](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-lint/pull/99) fails three existing checks on [Node 22 and 26](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-lint/actions/runs/45179154933). This is a dependency-adoption blocker, not a current release incident.

Independently reproduced at `28542ba2540905e6d7407457410738064a5e75a0` on Node 24.22.3 with disposable trackers. Build and test typecheck passed. With identical candidate dependencies except the installed official Core artifact, 2026.11.14 passes 3/3, and 2026.11.20 and 2026.11.23 each pass 0/3 on the same assertions.

- [Incremental command](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-lint/blob/28542ba2540905e6d7407457410738064a5e75a0/test/incremental.test.ts#L209): the missing-state call expects a compact `invalid_input` refusal, but Core now detects the absent declared `findings` collection before that result is delivered. Related [Core contract](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/1729).
- [Linked witness metadata](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-lint/blob/28542ba2540905e6d7407457410738064a5e75a0/test/witnesses.test.ts#L70): the legacy path-only fixture's `commitImportedItem` reports `committed: false` instead of true. Confirm supported legacy-read setup without bypassing validation.
- [Witness command context](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-lint/blob/28542ba2540905e6d7407457410738064a5e75a0/test/witnesses.test.ts#L169): the harness returns no exit code where the test assumes coordinates are absent and expects exit code 2. Test the valid scoped invocation separately from a genuinely missing-context refusal.

Focused test after installing and building: `node --test --test-name-pattern 'registered command renders compact refusals|current linked tests bind all metadata|registered host command renders success' test/incremental.test.ts test/witnesses.test.ts`.

Acceptance: current supported Core pin passes all three checks and the quick matrix; keep useful typed incremental refusals and declared read-output validation in both harness and packed CLI; preserve witness legacy-read and missing-context coverage. No full release gate run in this local comparison.
